## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
test/zaq/channels/disk_file_delivery_integration_test.exs and email_file_delivery_integration_test.exs, plus minimal test/CI provisioning. Existing datasource APIs create signed Records for two real Disk files; trusted Outgoing Event selects one. Real Materialization/Channels/Jido/Mailer. Mattermost recipient downloads actual post file; SMTP receiver raw MIME is decoded and compared. Keep fixtures/assertions reusable for later Agent scenarios.

## Tests to add before implementation
Scenarios defined now, authored after final feature review: exactly selected bytes/name/MIME, thread/audience/receipt; empty-attachment control; two concurrent journeys per channel and Mattermost/email together; observe overlap and no crossed resources or cleanup.

## Branches/paths validated
True delivery E2E boundary starts at Outgoing, no Agent/LLM/IMAP ingress claim. Existing ServerManager blocker matters only if actually reached. Agent PR adds ingress/tools later in same modules and retains these scenarios.

## Mocking plan
Real disposable Mattermost/PostgreSQL and SMTP receiver; no mocked upload/materialization/internal dispatch. Unique identities/connectors/mailboxes/files, private sandbox ownership and explicit process allowances. No Application env mutation, global Mox, shared default fixtures or fixed sleeps.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse existing provider provisioning/readback patterns and datasource permission APIs. Reuse zaq-o9d setup only where it satisfies real-server acceptance. Test helpers remain test-only; no production functions for observation.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.
